fact: Enrolment centres of the biometric civil status reform are operating in Guinea, with MGG as the state's technical partner, and users are being enrolled for biometric documents, which the authorities announced as free, per MGG.
The minister said ONECI is setting up the national register of natural persons (RNPP), with a national-scale biometric census carried out in 2025.
ID Tech Wire reports that biometric national ID card enrolment, free for first-time applicants aged 16 and over, began in Sanoyah commune on MOSIP and TECH5 infrastructure.

fact: ONECI's director-general says the biometric census of citizens in civil status centres is continuing and must not be interrupted, feeding the registre national des personnes physiques.
A workshop on extending the RNPP and building an identity verification and validation platform was launched by the territorial administration minister, who asked for its first phase before end-2026.

Jurist Sayon Mara writes that PN-RAVEC biometric enrolment of people aged 10 and over was officially launched on 15 April 2025, in a first phase of 45 days, to build the RNPP register of biographic and biometric data.

Decree D/2025/052 of 14 April 2025 defines the national register of natural persons as a database of biographic and biometric (fingerprint, photograph) data for identification, without stating that it is issuing numbers.
